_comment: that sets GLVidHeapReuseRatio=0 for known Wayland compositors such as
kwin_wayland and gnome-shell, so the driver stops hoarding freed video
memory and the compositor's memory use does not creep up over long
sessions. niri is not on NVIDIA's list; this adds it. Distinct file and
profile names so it adds to NVIDIA's rules instead of colliding with them.

rules.profile: Limit Free Buffer Pool In niri

profiles.name: Limit Free Buffer Pool In niri
